story.title: The lost and found boy
paragraphs_en: Ravi missed his home. He ran away from his home in his childhood.He is very poor now. He ran away from his home without bringing his debit card or phone. He is a young man now without any home, money or work. He was very hungry but he didn't have money so he went to a hotel and said, ''Please give me some work, so that I can buy food and eat."

The hotel manager said, 'Yes,you can serve our customers,and in return I will give you some money." That day Ravi was very happy to get a job. Next morning, some customers arrived in the hotel. Ravi was in-charge of the new customers, he didn't know it was his family.His family also didn't know that his son was working in this hotel.

Then he went to the room where his parents were living. The parents talked to him normally as they would to a hotel attendant. In the midst of the conversation, Ravi mentioned about his childhood days and hometown. The parents started connecting it with their missing son. They showed Ravi his childhood photographs with the family. This picture was clear in Ravi's mind. He started crying and asking for forgiveness. The family was overjoyed to find their missing son after a long time.

sentences.text_vi: Giờ cậu ấy là một người đàn ông trẻ, không nhà, không tiền, không việc làm.

sentences.text_vi: Cậu ấy rất đói nhưng không có tiền, nên cậu ấy đến một khách sạn và nói: "Làm ơn cho cháu một việc gì đó, để cháu có thể mua đồ ăn và ăn ạ."

sentences.text_en: The hotel manager said, 'Yes,you can serve our customers,and in return I will give you some money." That day Ravi was very happy to get a job.
sentences.text_vi: Người quản lý khách sạn nói: "Được thôi, cháu có thể phục vụ khách hàng của chúng tôi, và đổi lại, chú sẽ trả cháu một ít tiền." Ngày hôm đó, Ravi rất vui khi có được việc làm.

sentences.text_en: Next morning, some customers arrived in the hotel.
sentences.text_vi: Sáng hôm sau, một vài khách hàng đến khách sạn.

sentences.text_en: Ravi was in-charge of the new customers, he didn't know it was his family.His family also didn't know that his son was working in this hotel.
sentences.text_vi: Ravi được giao phụ trách những khách hàng mới, cậu ấy không biết đó là gia đình mình. Gia đình cậu ấy cũng không biết con trai mình đang làm việc ở khách sạn này.

sentences.text_en: Then he went to the room where his parents were living.
sentences.text_vi: Sau đó, cậu ấy đến căn phòng nơi bố mẹ mình đang ở.

sentences.text_en: The parents talked to him normally as they would to a hotel attendant.
sentences.text_vi: Bố mẹ nói chuyện với cậu ấy bình thường như nói chuyện với một nhân viên khách sạn.

sentences.text_en: In the midst of the conversation, Ravi mentioned about his childhood days and hometown.
sentences.text_vi: Trong lúc nói chuyện, Ravi nhắc đến những ngày thơ ấu và quê hương của mình.

sentences.text_en: The parents started connecting it with their missing son.
sentences.text_vi: Bố mẹ bắt đầu liên tưởng câu chuyện đó với người con trai mất tích của họ.

sentences.text_en: They showed Ravi his childhood photographs with the family.
sentences.text_vi: Họ cho Ravi xem những bức ảnh thời thơ ấu của cậu ấy chụp cùng gia đình.

sentences.text_en: This picture was clear in Ravi's mind.
sentences.text_vi: Bức ảnh này hiện rõ trong tâm trí Ravi.

sentences.text_en: He started crying and asking for forgiveness.
sentences.text_vi: Cậu ấy bắt đầu khóc và xin tha thứ.

sentences.text_en: The family was overjoyed to find their missing son after a long time.
sentences.text_vi: Gia đình vô cùng vui mừng khi tìm thấy người con trai mất tích sau một thời gian dài.
